unitTitle: Adjectives/Adverbs - Linking Words - Prepositions of Movement
scanNote: Kitobda bu betning yuqori sarlavhasi NOTO'G'RI bosilgan — u yerda 12-unitning sarlavhasi ('Present Perfect - Past Simple - Ever/Never ...') turibdi. Bet raqami (11) va butun mazmun 11-unitga tegishli. Bu — kitobdagi bosma xato.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the correct adjective from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi to'g'ri sifat bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (5 ta sifat, 5 ta bo'shliq):
  interesting, gorgeous, happy, strange, careful

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

USUL — KEYINGI GAPGA QARANG:
  Har bir bandda IKKINChI qism javobni ochib beradi.
     'He never has accidents.'  → careful
     'when she won first prize'  → happy

DIQQAT — 'A(N)' YOZUVI:
  Kitobda 'a(n)' deb yozilgan — chunki javobga qarab
  'a' yoki 'an' bo'ladi:
     AN interesting film   (unli tovush)
     A careful driver      (undosh tovush)
     A strange man         (undosh)
     A gorgeous day        (undosh)

  Faqat 'interesting' UNLI tovush bilan boshlanadi.

items.textEn: 1  There was a(n) ............ film on television last night.
items.hintUz: 'a(n)' — qaysi sifat UNLI tovush bilan boshlanadi?
items.whyUz:
'AN INTERESTING film' = qiziqarli film.
DIQQAT: 'interesting' — 'i' UNLI tovush → AN.
Ro'yxatdagi YAGONA 'an' oladigan so'z —
bu javobni tekshirishning yaxshi usuli.

items.textEn: 2  Carlos is a(n) ............ driver. He never has accidents.
items.hintUz: Hech qachon halokatga uchramaydigan haydovchi qanday?
items.whyUz:
'A CAREFUL driver' = ehtiyotkor haydovchi.
Keyingi gap tushuntiradi: 'He never has accidents'.
48-betdagi nazariyada ham shu misol bor edi.

items.textEn: 3  There was a(n) ............ man looking through my kitchen window.
items.hintUz: Oshxona derazasidan qarab turgan notanish odam
items.whyUz:
'A STRANGE man' = g'alati, notanish odam.
Coursebook 78-betdagi 10a-mashqda ham 'strange voices' bor edi.
'look THROUGH a window' — 78-betdagi predlog.

items.textEn: 4  It was a(n) ............ spring day so they went on a picnic.
items.whyUz:
'A GORGEOUS spring day' = ajoyib bahor kuni.
'gorgeous' = ajoyib, go'zal.
Coursebook 77-betdagi hikoya ham shunday boshlangan:
'One GORGEOUS, sunny day'.
'so' — natija bog'lovchisi (48-bet).

items.textEn: 5  Kate was very ............ when she won first prize in the art competition.
items.hintUz: Birinchi o'rinni olgan odam nima his qiladi?
items.whyUz:
'very HAPPY' = juda xursand.
'win first prize' = birinchi o'rinni olmoq.
DIQQAT: 'was' dan keyin SIFAT keladi (ravish emas) —
48-betdagi qoida.
'when' — vaqt bog'lovchisi.

exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI SIFAT — UChALA QOIDA HAM SINALADI:

  UNDOSH + Y → -ILY:
     easy   → easily
     happy  → happily
     sleepy → sleepily

  ODDIY + LY:
     proud → proudly
     close → closely

  ISTISNO:
     good → WELL

DIQQAT — 'CLOSE' IKKI XIL O'QILADI:
  'close' SIFAT/RAVISh (/kləʊs/) = yaqin
     He lives CLOSE to the school.
  'close' FE'L (/kləʊz/) = yopmoq
     Please CLOSE the door.
  Ravishi: CLOSELY (/ˈkləʊsli/) = diqqat bilan, yaqindan
     Look CLOSELY at the picture.

items.whyUz:
easy → EASILY.
's' undosh + 'y' → 'y' tushadi, -ILY qo'shiladi.
'He passed the test easily.' = Testdan osonlik bilan o'tdi.

proud → proudly.
'proud' = faxrlanuvchi → 'proudly' = faxr bilan.
'He smiled proudly.' = U faxr bilan jilmaydi.

happy → HAPPILY.
'p' undosh + 'y' → -ILY.
Coursebook 79-betdagi namunada ham bor:
'The child smiled HAPPILY.'

good → WELL.
'goodly' shakli YO'Q.
48-betdagi 'Note: good → well' qoidasi.
'He sings WELL.' = U yaxshi kuylaydi.

close → CLOSELY.
Oxiri '-e' bo'lsa ham faqat -LY qo'shiladi.
'Look CLOSELY' = diqqat bilan qarang.
DIQQAT: 'close' sifat sifatida ham RAVISh bo'ladi —
'He lives CLOSE to the school' (yaqin).

sleepy → SLEEPILY.
'p' undosh + 'y' → -ILY.
Coursebook 81-betdagi 21-mashqda bor edi:
'he went SLEEPILY to the window'.

exercises.explanationUz:
O'N SIFAT — ko'pchiligi Coursebook 11-unitidan tanish.

HAMMASI ODDIY + LY, faqat IKKITASI ISTISNO:
  fast → FAST   (shakli O'ZGARMAYDI)
  hard → HARD   (shakli O'ZGARMAYDI)

DIQQAT — 8 va 10-BANDLAR TUZOQ:
  'fastly' shakli YO'Q.
  'hardly' shakli BOR, lekin ma'nosi 'deyarli emas' —
  bu yerda kerak emas.

items.whyUz:
tight → tightly.
Coursebook 77-betda: 'closed the car windows TIGHTLY'.

loud → loudly.
Coursebook 77-betda: 'The lions roared LOUDLY'.

sudden → suddenly.
Hikoyalarda BURILISh nuqtasini bildiradi.

desperate → desperately.
Coursebook 77-betda: 'Claire screamed DESPERATELY'.

quick → quickly.
Coursebook 77-betda: 'jumped out of the car QUICKLY'.

nervous → nervously.
Coursebook 81-betdagi 21-mashqda bor edi.

immediate → immediately.
Coursebook 80-betda: 'ALMOST IMMEDIATELY, another jeep
arrived'.

fast → FAST.
'fastly' shakli YO'Q.
48-betdagi 3-qoida.
'She can run FAST.' = U tez yugura oladi.

careful → carefully.
48-betdagi asosiy namuna: 'He drives CAREFULLY'.

hard → HARD.
48-betdagi 3-qoida.
'He works HARD.' = U ko'p ishlaydi.
DIQQAT: 'hardly' shakli BOR, lekin ma'nosi
'DEYARLI EMAS' — butunlay boshqa:
'He HARDLY works' = U deyarli ishlamaydi.

exercises.explanationUz:
SIFATMI YOKI RAVIShMI — QANDAY ANIQLASH:

  RAVISh KERAK — agar u FE'LNI aniqlasa:
     John dressed QUICKLY.  (qanday kiyindi?)
     She shouted LOUDLY.    (qanday qichqirdi?)

  SIFAT KERAK — agar u OTNI yoki EGANI aniqlasa:
     a CARELESS driver      (qanday haydovchi?)
     You are LUCKY.         ('are' dan keyin)
     He was PROUD.          ('was' dan keyin)


ENG MUHIM ISTISNO — 'LOOK', 'FEEL', 'SEEM' FE'LLARI:

  Bu fe'llardan keyin RAVISh emas, SIFAT keladi —
  chunki ular EGANI tasvirlaydi, harakatni emas.

     She looked BEAUTIFUL.     ✓  (u go'zal ko'rindi)
     She looked BEAUTIFULLY.   ✗ XATO

     He felt FRIGHTENED.       ✓
     It seems EASY.            ✓

  DIQQAT — 'LOOK' IKKI XIL MA'NODA:
     'look' = ko'rinmoq  → SIFAT keladi
        She looks HAPPY.
     'look at' = qaramoq → RAVISh keladi
        She looked at it CAREFULLY.


USUL — SAVOL BERING:
  'HOW ...?' (qanday qilib?)  → RAVISh
  'WHAT KIND OF ...?' (qanday?) → SIFAT

items.textEn: 1  John dressed quick / quickly and went to work.
items.whyUz:
'dressed' FE'LINI aniqlaydi → RAVISh → QUICKLY.
Savol: qanday kiyindi? Tez.
'to dress' = kiyinmoq.

items.textEn: 2  She looked beautiful / beautifully on her wedding day.
items.whyUz:
'look' = KO'RINMOQ (harakat emas!) → SIFAT → BEAUTIFUL.
Ma'nosi: u go'zal KO'RINDI.
DIQQAT — ENG MUHIM ISTISNO:
'look', 'feel', 'seem' fe'llaridan keyin SIFAT keladi.
'She looked beautifully' XATO.

items.textEn: 3  Sudden / Suddenly it started to rain.
items.whyUz:
'SUDDENLY' — RAVISh, butun gapga tegishli.
Gap boshida turadi.
'Sudden' SIFAT bo'lgani uchun bu yerda mos kelmaydi
(otdan oldin turishi kerak edi: 'a sudden noise').

items.textEn: 4  Richard can paint very good / well.
items.whyUz:
'paint' FE'LINI aniqlaydi → RAVISh kerak.
'good' ning ravishi — WELL (48-betdagi istisno).
'He can paint very GOOD' XATO — juda ko'p uchraydigan xato.

items.textEn: 5  Hannah desperate / desperately tried to open the window.
items.whyUz:
'tried' FE'LINI aniqlaydi → RAVISh → DESPERATELY.
Savol: qanday urindi? Jon holatda.
DIQQAT: ravish bu yerda fe'ldan OLDIN turibdi.

items.textEn: 6  You are very lucky / luckily you weren't hurt.
items.whyUz:
'are' ('to be') dan keyin SIFAT keladi → LUCKY.
Ma'nosi: siz omadlisiz.
'You are luckily' XATO.
'to be hurt' = jarohat olmoq.

items.textEn: 7  Don won first prize and was very proud / proudly.
items.whyUz:
'was' ('to be') dan keyin SIFAT keladi → PROUD.
Ma'nosi: u juda faxrlanardi.
6-band bilan bir xil qoida.
Coursebook 79-betdagi 16-mashqda ham 'He felt PROUD'.

items.textEn: 8  "Help, help me!" she shouted loud / loudly.
items.whyUz:
'shouted' FE'LINI aniqlaydi → RAVISh → LOUDLY.
Savol: qanday qichqirdi? Baland ovozda.

items.textEn: 9  My sister is a very careless / carelessly driver.
items.whyUz:
'driver' OTINI aniqlaydi → SIFAT → CARELESS.
Savol: qanday haydovchi? Ehtiyotsiz.
'careless' = ehtiyotsiz ('careful' ning aksi).
'-less' qo'shimchasi 'siz' ma'nosini beradi:
care + less = g'amxo'rliksiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the sentences, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI GAP BOShI (chap ustun) va
YETTI GAP DAVOMI (o'ng ustun).

Kitob BIRINI chizib bergan: 1 → d

USUL — BOG'LOVChIGA QARANG:
  O'ng ustundagi har bir gap BOG'LOVChI bilan boshlanadi:
     a  SO ...       → natija
     b  BECAUSE ...  → sabab
     c  BUT ...      → qarama-qarshilik
     d  BECAUSE ...  → sabab
     e  AND ...      → qo'shimcha
     f  WHEN ...     → vaqt
     g  THEN ...     → ketma-ketlik

  So'ng chap ustundagi gapga MANTIQAN mos kelishini
  tekshiring.

pairs.right: d  because I wanted to wear it to the party.
pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDA ChIZILGAN.
BECAUSE — yuvishning SABABI.
'wear it TO the party' — predlog TO.

pairs.right: a  so I took my umbrella.
pairs.whyUz:
SO — yomg'irning NATIJASI.
Yomg'ir → soyabon olish.
take → TOOK (noto'g'ri fe'l).

pairs.right: f  when I heard a strange noise.
pairs.whyUz:
WHEN — VAQT.
Davom etayotgan holat (to'shakda edim) +
to'satdan bo'lgan voqea (shovqin eshitdim).
48-betdagi 'He was at work WHEN he heard the news'
bilan bir xil naqsh.

AND — ketma-ketlik.
Uyg'onish → nonushta — tabiiy ketma-ketlik.
wake → WOKE (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'have breakfast' — artiklsiz.

pairs.right: g  then she went to bed.
pairs.whyUz:
THEN — ketma-ketlik.
Pijama kiyish → yotish.
'put on' = kiymoq;  put → PUT (o'zgarmaydi).
'go to bed' — artiklsiz.

pairs.right: c  but he failed the test.
pairs.whyUz:
BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIK.
Ko'p o'qidi ↔ lekin yiqildi — kutilmagan natija.
'study HARD' — 'hardly' EMAS (3-mashqning 10-bandi).
'to fail a test' = testdan yiqilmoq.

BECAUSE — sotib olmaslikning SABABI.
'expensive' = qimmat (aksi: cheap = arzon).

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text and fill in and, but, so, because or when.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing va and, but, so, because yoki when ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: and, but, so, because, when

5 ta bog'lovchi, 10 ta bo'shliq — demak ba'zilari
BIR NEChA MARTA ishlatiladi:
  and     → 3 marta
  but     → 2 marta
  so      → 2 marta
  when    → 2 marta
  because → 1 marta

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Sally was tired, SO she decided to go to bed. She was
  asleep WHEN the telephone rang. She got up AND answered
  the phone BUT no one spoke on the other end. Sally hung
  up the phone AND went back to bed. She couldn't sleep, SO
  she went into the kitchen AND made some tea. She was
  still in the kitchen WHEN the phone rang again. Sally
  didn't want to answer it, BUT she did. Once again, no one
  spoke on the other end. Sally hung up the phone. She felt
  nervous BECAUSE she was alone in the house. Suddenly,
  there was a knock at the door!


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Salli charchagan edi, shuning uchun yotishga qaror qildi.
  U uxlab yotgan edi, o'shanda telefon jiringladi. U turdi
  va telefonga javob berdi, lekin narigi tomondan hech kim
  gapirmadi. Salli go'shakni qo'ydi va yana yotdi. U uxlay
  olmadi, shuning uchun oshxonaga bordi va choy damladi. U
  hali oshxonada edi, o'shanda telefon yana jiringladi.
  Salli javob bermoqchi emas edi, lekin javob berdi. Yana
  bir bor narigi tomondan hech kim gapirmadi. Salli
  go'shakni qo'ydi. U asabiylashdi, chunki uyda yolg'iz
  edi. To'satdan eshik taqilladi!

DIQQAT — BU HAM HIKOYA:
  Matn qo'rqinchli hikoya uslubida yozilgan.
  Oxiri ochiq qoldirilgan ('Suddenly, there was a knock
  at the door!') — bu Coursebook 79 va 81-betlardagi
  hikoya yozish qoidalariga mos.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  asleep       = uxlab yotgan
  to ring (rang) = jiringlamoq
  to hang up   = go'shakni qo'ymoq
  on the other end = narigi tomonda (telefonda)
  once again   = yana bir bor
  alone        = yolg'iz
  a knock      = taqillatish
  to make tea  = choy damlamoq

items.textEn: 1  Sally was tired, ............ she decided to go to bed.
items.whyUz:
SABAB (charchagan) → NATIJA (yotishga qaror qildi) → SO.
Oldidan VERGUL bor — bu ham 'so' ni ko'rsatadi.
48-betdagi misolga o'xshash:
'I was very tired, SO I decided to go to bed.'

items.textEn: 2  She was asleep ............ the telephone rang.
items.whyUz:
WHEN — VAQT.
Davom etayotgan holat (uxlab yotgan) +
to'satdan bo'lgan voqea (telefon jiringladi).
ring → RANG (noto'g'ri fe'l).

items.textEn: 3  She got up ............ answered the phone ...
items.hintUz: Ikki harakat ketma-ket, ega BIR XIL
items.whyUz:
AND — ketma-ketlik.
DIQQAT: ikkinchi qismda ega ('she') TUShIB QOLGAN —
'she got up and (she) answered' — bu 'and' belgisi.
'get up' = o'rnidan turmoq.

items.textEn: 4  ... ............ no one spoke on the other end.
items.whyUz:
BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIK.
Telefonga javob berdi ↔ lekin hech kim gapirmadi —
kutilmagan natija.
speak → SPOKE (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'on the other end' = narigi tomonda (telefonda).

items.textEn: 5  Sally hung up the phone ............ went back to bed.
items.whyUz:
AND — ketma-ketlik.
Ega yana TUShIB QOLGAN: 'Sally hung up ... and (she) went'.
'hang up' = go'shakni qo'ymoq;  hang → HUNG.
'go back' = qaytmoq.

items.textEn: 6  She couldn't sleep, ............ she went into the kitchen ...
items.whyUz:
SABAB (uxlay olmadi) → NATIJA (oshxonaga bordi) → SO.
Oldidan VERGUL bor.
1-band bilan bir xil mantiq.
'go INTO' — harakat predlogi (48-bet).

AND — ketma-ketlik.
Ega TUShIB QOLGAN: 'she went into the kitchen and (she)
made some tea'.
'make tea' = choy damlamoq (do EMAS, MAKE).

items.textEn: 8  She was still in the kitchen ............ the phone rang again.
items.whyUz:
WHEN — VAQT.
2-band bilan bir xil naqsh: davom etayotgan holat
(oshxonada edi) + to'satdan bo'lgan voqea.
'still' = hali ham.

items.textEn: 9  Sally didn't want to answer it, ............ she did.
items.whyUz:
BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIK.
Xohlamadi ↔ lekin qildi.
'she DID' = she did answer it —
'did' takrorlanmaslik uchun asosiy fe'l o'rniga turibdi.
4-band bilan bir xil mantiq.

items.textEn: 10  She felt nervous ............ she was alone in the house.
items.whyUz:
BECAUSE — SABAB.
'she was alone' — asabiylashishning sababi.
Ro'yxatdagi 'because' YAGONA marta shu yerda ishlatiladi.
'feel nervous' — 'feel' dan keyin SIFAT (4-mashqning qoidasi).
'alone' = yolg'iz.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in and, but, because, so, then or when.
exercises.instructionUz: and, but, because, so, then yoki when ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI BOG'LOVChI, OLTI GAP —
har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

Bu tekshirish uchun yaxshi belgi: agar bittasi
ikki marta chiqsa, biror joyda xato qilgansiz.

USUL — IKKINChI QISMGA SAVOL BERING:
  'Nega?' javobi bormi?          → BECAUSE
  Birinchisining NATIJASImi?      → SO
  QARAMA-QARShImi?                → BUT
  'Qachon?' javobi bormi?         → WHEN
  'First' bor, keyin nima?        → THEN
  Shunchaki ketma-ketlikmi?       → AND

items.textEn: 1  Mike got up early ............ he wanted to study for his test.
items.whyUz:
BECAUSE — SABAB.
'he wanted to study' — erta turishning sababi.
'study FOR a test' = testga tayyorlanmoq.

items.textEn: 2  First, I went to the supermarket, ............ I went to the post office.
items.whyUz:
THEN — ketma-ketlik.
'First' so'zi bor → uning juftligi 'THEN'.
Coursebook 77-betdagi ketma-ketlik so'zlari:
first, then, after that, finally.

items.textEn: 3  Sophie was hungry, ............ she made a sandwich.
items.whyUz:
SO — NATIJA.
SABAB (och edi) → NATIJA (buterbrod tayyorladi).
Oldidan VERGUL bor.
'make a sandwich' — 'do' EMAS, MAKE.

items.textEn: 4  He turned off the lights ............ went to bed.
items.hintUz: Ikki harakat ketma-ket, ega BIR XIL
items.whyUz:
AND — ketma-ketlik.
DIQQAT: ikkinchi qismda ega ('he') TUShIB QOLGAN —
bu 'and' ning aniq belgisi.
'turn off' = o'chirmoq (aksi: turn on = yoqmoq).

items.textEn: 5  I was happy ............ I heard the great news.
items.whyUz:
WHEN — VAQT.
'I heard the great news' — xursand bo'lgan PAYT.
hear → HEARD (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'the news' — SANALMAYDIGAN, doim 'the' bilan.

items.textEn: 6  David likes rock music, ............ his sister doesn't.
items.whyUz:
BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIK.
'David LIKES' ↔ 'his sister DOESN'T' — teskari.
Oldidan VERGUL bor.
'doesn't' = doesn't like rock music (qisqartirilgan).
Coursebook 79-betdagi 12-mashqning 10-bandiga o'xshash.

groups.ruleUz: SIFATMI YOKI RAVIShMI — hal qiluvchi savol

groups.explanationUz: Ma'no o'zgarsa, keyingi so'z turi ham o'zgaradi.

patterns.formula: Ega + FE'L + RAVISh.   ↔   Ega + IS/WAS + SIFAT.
patterns.exampleEn: John dressed quickly. You are very lucky.
patterns.exampleUz: Jon tez kiyindi. Siz juda omadlisiz.
patterns.explanationUz:
Fe'lni aniqlasa → RAVISh.
'to be' dan keyin → SIFAT.

patterns.exampleEn: She looked beautiful on her wedding day.
patterns.explanationUz:
ENG MUHIM ISTISNO:
'look', 'feel', 'seem' dan keyin RAVISh EMAS, SIFAT keladi.

patterns.exampleEn: Sally was tired, so she decided to go to bed. She felt nervous because she was alone.
patterns.exampleUz: Salli charchagan edi, shuning uchun yotishga qaror qildi. U asabiylashdi, chunki yolg'iz edi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'so' — SABAB + so + NATIJA;
'because' — NATIJA + because + SABAB.

patterns.formula: Ega + WAS + holat + WHEN + to'satdan bo'lgan voqea.
patterns.exampleEn: She was asleep when the telephone rang. I was in bed when I heard a strange noise.
patterns.exampleUz: U uxlab yotgan edi, o'shanda telefon jiringladi. Men to'shakda edim, o'shanda g'alati shovqin eshitdim.
patterns.explanationUz:
'when' — davom etayotgan holatni va to'satdan bo'lgan
voqeani bog'laydi.

patterns.exampleEn: She got up and answered the phone. He turned off the lights and went to bed.
patterns.exampleUz: U turdi va telefonga javob berdi. U chiroqlarni o'chirdi va yotdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ega BIR XIL bo'lsa, ikkinchi qismda tushirib qoldiriladi.
Bu — 'and' ning aniq belgisi.

patterns.exampleEn: First, I went to the supermarket, then I went to the post office.
patterns.exampleUz: Avval supermarketga bordim, so'ng pochtaga bordim.
